rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation and scope; i1040gi p. 90, worksheet line 1: "Enter the income tax refund from Form(s) 1099-G (or similar statement). But don’t enter more than the amount of your state and local income taxes shown on your 2024 Schedule A, line 5d". Where the worksheet is used (itemized, no sales-tax election) the candidate takes the same smaller of refund.received and line 5d; it enters zero otherwise, where the project's refund.taxable never reads line 1. stage16.refuse.refund.box8 and .not_2024 (candidate refuses on line 1, project $3,000.00 on line 1 and refuses the same returns at refund.taxable) are scope on refused returns. The completed-return differences (refund.itemized, box8 or not_2024 withheld from the candidate; refund.line5d_2024 withheld from the project) are partial records on bases with no refund: Every partial base of the bank is a return with no refund (refund.received $0.00), and s1.line1 reads the worksheet only when refund.has (refund.received more than zero) is true (forms/2025/s1.yaml), so the partial-record differences on those bases are on lines the return never reads. No value differs. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/refund.deepseek.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 385 partial records from 40 bases; 2,380 comparisons): 2,263 agree; differences 2 candidate-refuses, 69 candidate-unknown, 46 project-unknown; on completed returns 39 candidate-unknown, 13 project-unknown; every completed-return witness enumerated by an uncapped scratch rerun of the same evaluator (the record keeps 6 per kind). Project stands.

Ruling: representation; i1040gi p. 90, worksheet line 1: "Enter the income tax refund from Form(s) 1099-G (or similar statement). But don't enter more than the amount of your state and local income taxes shown on your 2024 Schedule A, line 5d"; p. 88: the worksheet is used "If the refund was for a tax you paid in 2024 and you deducted state and local income taxes on your 2024 Schedule A". Where the worksheet is used (itemized, no sales-tax election) the candidate takes the same smaller of refund.received and line 5d; it enters zero otherwise, where the project's refund.taxable never reads line 1. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/refund.deepseek.json; 1,083 fixtures, 500 generated returns, 295 partial records over 17 bases): 1,791 of 1,878 agree. The 34 project-unknown records (17 bases withholding refund.received or refund.line5d_2024) and the 51 candidate-unknown records (withholding refund.itemized, refund.box8 or refund.not_2024) are partial records on which the candidate yields $0.00, so its eligibility test is false there and the worksheet is not reached; in the interview refund.itemized, box 8 and not_2024 are answered on refund.taxable before line 1 is read. The 2 candidate-refuses records (stage16.refuse.refund.box8, not_2024; project line 1 $3,000.00) are returns the project refuses on refund.taxable under the same gates, scope. No printed amount differs.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 90, worksheet line 6: "Spouse was born before January 2, 1960. Spouse is blind." with "*If your filing status is married filing separately, you can check the boxes for your spouse only if your spouse had no income", and i1040gi p. 33, Line 12d (given to the reviewer): "Don't check any boxes for your spouse if your filing status is head of household". The project asks the spouse boxes only for a 2024 joint or separate return (amb.2025.refund_boxes_2024); the candidate asks refund.spouse_born and refund.spouse_blind of every filer, including single and head of household, answers the text does not need. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/refund.deepseek.json; 1,083 fixtures, 500 generated returns, 295 partial records over 17 bases): 1,826 of 1,878 agree.
